title: Recommended tools for AI coding?
author: DryInsect1308
selftext:
Hello   
Just a quick question as this seems to be the right place.  
I’m working on a dream game of mine (an avid KSP and everything space related veteran, roughly 8k hours across different games), roughly a Space Program Management Game.  
So far I have been using multiple instances of free OpenCode for my code work (1-4 features a day) and I’m planning to switch to paid models after I have a demo I enjoy playing (so looking at my pace, between mid-January to Valentine’s Day) and I wanted to seek other free AI services that are right for me. I’m working in Godot with C#, with a python pipeline to slice bodies into hexagons using Ubers H3. If everything goes well, I’m planning to pay around 20$/month for Claude API and 20$ for opencodes Big Pickle whenever it runs out. I’ve been working for around 2 weeks now, with a 60/40 split between planning and drawing everything out & actually implementing it.

In summary, I need a free project manager to discuss and plan with, and one or two programming agents to actually implement everything, eventually using their paid version when the time comes.   
Can you please share your views on this, recommend models, agents, routers? A good but not necessarily prioritized addition would be a concept art capable model, as I’m not exactly a visionary when it comes to creating models and textures from my imagination, but I’m rather capable at using references I can check against. I do not want to hand over the graphic design to AI, just logic and idea refining.

I have already used Big Pickle at work to create an ITAM system for my company, so from my point of view this model is rather capable, but I’d like to hear you first.

comments.author: Ferniclestix
comments.body:
claude pro is pretty good, if you use the client it has directory level access.  limits are a bit trash if you wanna do multi agent though.

Gemini is basically trash, although if you pay for it you can use ai studio to run multiple different models because each one has its own token limits so if one runs out you can switch to another.

the gemini voice TTS models are really good if you are looking for voice, they can do tone and emotion. althouhg it invisibly caps out at like 34 minutes after that it wont let you download the file.

cos the google ai studio interface is fking atrocious.

sorry cant help more than that. good luck man.
